title: Global initialization layer flags, progress owner, and waiter synchronization state

scope.rationale: These seven Sqlite3Config fields are the complete initialization-progress and per-layer state read or written by sqlite3_initialize/shutdown. Coordinator and subsystem owners now preserve partial-success state across late failures.
excluded_responsibilities: Concrete PCache/OS resources represented by the flags

external_source_responsibilities: Independent event review of scoped OS/VFS state publication
dependencies.caller_closure: Every source layer flag and init progress/waiter identity has a production representation consumed by global-library-initialize-shutdown.

inputs: Concurrent, recursive, successful, partially failed, retried, and shutdown lifecycle events
outputs: Exact initialized/progress and per-layer ownership state needed to skip completed work and clean partial initialization
contracts.ownership: Coordinator owns process init progress/waiters; mutex Subsystem, memory Manager, and page_cache.Lifecycle own their layer flags/resources.
contracts.state_and_results: isInit is set only after all layers succeed. Late failure preserves completed mutex/malloc/pcache layers. Recursive owner returns immediately; other callers wait. Shutdown clears each initialized layer in source order.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: state_lock/state_changed/owner replace pInitMutex+nRefInitMutex for serialization; configured STATIC_MAIN and recursive init handles remain allocated so source callback and OOM behavior is retained. No I/O at representation level.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Partial layer state survives failure so retry skips completed layers; shutdown cleans partial state even when isInit is false.

representation_differences: C uses seven scalar/pointer fields plus recursive pInitMutex reference counting; Zig uses an explicit State enum, owner id, condition variable, and subsystem-owned initialized booleans.
nRefInitMutex waiter lifetime is represented by condition-variable waiters rather than an exposed counter.
isMallocInit and isMutexInit are the authoritative Manager.started and Subsystem.initialized values, avoiding duplicate flags.

oracle.protocol: Infrastructure differential compares 100 lifecycle cycles, an eight-thread race, and configured mutex/PCache failure-retry state. Native tests cover same-thread recursion with repeated xMutexInit, recursive init-handle OOM, configured mutex layers, late failure preserving mutex/malloc/pcache state, retry, partial shutdown, and production owner state.
oracle.normalization: Explicit enum/condition representation replaces pointer/refcount addresses; layer booleans, callback events, results, and ordering are exact.

assurance.oom: Allocator/mutex failure state is represented; per-cache allocation OOM remains outside this representation unit.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O at representation level. Eight-thread and recursive races pass; formal event proof remains pending.
assurance.continuation: Late failure retry and partial shutdown continuation are tested.
assurance.performance: Condition variable replaces source refcounted recursive mutex; contention benchmark/review remains open.

integration.production_owner: src/core/global.zig process_coordinator plus process mutex/memory owners
integration.native_call_path: public sqlite3_initialize/shutdown and auto-init paths share these production fields.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Direct memory-only public lifecycle and duplicate production init flags are retired.

independent_review.notes: Must verify partial failures, waiter/refcount equivalence, shutdown races/preconditions, and layer integration.

known_blockers: PCache and scoped OS/VFS process state owners are trace-equivalent; independent publication review remains open.
Condition-variable versus nRefInitMutex event/performance equivalence needs independent review.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/sqliteInt.h:4313-4325 was reviewed for all seven post-configuration initialization fields and their zero-initialized boundary
upstream/sqlite/src/global.c:238-310 was reviewed for sqlite3Config initial values, including all seven fields initialized to zero
upstream/sqlite/src/main.c:195-419 was reviewed completely for initialize/shutdown reads, writes, waiter reference counting, partial layers, publication, and cleanup
src/core/global.zig Coordinator state/owner/state_lock/state_changed plus mutex, memory, and PCache layer-owned flags are the canonical AST-hashed targets
callers: sqlite3_initialize exclusively transitions isInit/inProgress/isMutexInit/isMallocInit/isPCacheInit/nRefInitMutex/pInitMutex during process startup
sqlite3_shutdown clears initialized OS, PCache, malloc, and mutex layers, including partial initialization when isInit is false
Public and auto-initialization paths converge on sqlite3_initialize/shutdown; concrete layer behavior belongs to global-library-initialize-shutdown
callees: Representation fields have no callees; lifecycle behavior calls mutex, allocator, PCache, OS, memdb, and built-in initialization owners
Zig explicit State, recursive owner, condition variable, and subsystem flags replace the C recursive mutex/reference-count representation without changing observable layer state
Publication barriers and callback ordering are behavior obligations, not declaration behavior
assertions_branches_cleanup: No behavioral blocks belong to these declarations; all fields begin zero/null and isInit is published only after all required layers succeed
Late failures retain successfully initialized mutex/malloc/PCache flags; retry skips those layers and shutdown cleans partial state
pInitMutex is released when nRefInitMutex reaches zero; Zig waiters use state_changed under state_lock instead of exposing the count
No I/O or allocation occurs at representation level
upstream_tests: upstream/sqlite/test/mutex2.test and init tests exercise failed initialization, retry, repeated calls, and shutdown
upstream/sqlite/test/thread001.test and thread_common.tcl provide concurrent initialization coverage
Project global tests and infrastructure differential cover 100 cycles, eight-thread races, recursion, layer failures, partial shutdown, and retry; receipts remain later
